reviewContext: President-authorized integration of the generative ship geometry contract: quadratic-family parameter/dynamic geometry, logistic-to-quadratic conjugacy, full 4D c/z state with explicit 3D projections, folded/ghost/unfolded dynamic fibers, sector-local materialization and structural operations, explicit coupling requirements, candidate-verify-commit invariants, counterfactual branch safety, and Feigenbaum asymptotic scaling for verified adaptive refinement, implemented as offline deterministic kernel primitives without touching Supabase/PostgreSQL
reviewedSemantics: the current candidate ship generator is the complex quadratic family Q_c(z)=z^2+c with c as parameter-space address and z as dynamical state under a declared initial condition and numeric contract

the kernel explicitly rejects the simplification that every c has one stable scalar fixed point; instead each declared c and initial/numeric contract define one canonical orbit/dynamics whose regime may be fixed, periodic, more complex bounded, neutral/boundary, or escaping
the logistic family x_next=r*x*(1-x) is linked to the real quadratic family by z=r*(1/2-x) and c=r*(2-r)/4 and this conjugacy is covered by deterministic tests

the exact combined mathematical state is represented as four coordinates Re(c), Im(c), Re(z), Im(z); any XY plus Z diagnostic view is explicitly a projection and cannot silently become canonical full state
dynamic fibers c -> O(c) may remain FOLDED or GHOST while reproducible and be locally UNFOLDED only when a bounded computation, inspection or proof requires materialization
the project term ghost petals denotes unmaterialized reproducible dynamic fibers and is not asserted to be a separate mathematical object
ship anatomy is represented as parameter domains/sectors plus law versions, variables, coupling references, causal patches and proofs rather than as a permanently authoritative dense mesh

FOLD is lossless only after exact regeneration inputs, numeric semantics, irreversible causes and required proof/checkpoint material are preserved; Mission Gate blocks discarding geometry without exact unfold proof

sector operations include FOLD, UNFOLD, COPY, VISUAL_MOVE, PARAMETER_MOVE, SWAP, SPAWN and DETACH; visual movement is presentation-only while parameter movement changes mathematical address and requires affected dynamics to be recomputed

quadratic dynamics at each c do not by themselves define cross-sector reaction; all automatic cross-sector effects require an explicit versioned coupling/dependency law and unknown coupling semantics require review
canonical structural mutation follows CANDIDATE -> VERIFY_INVARIANTS -> COMMIT and uncertain changes should be evaluated first on a counterfactual branch sharing the immutable prefix

the verified invariants include law/version compatibility, valid parameter domains, complete numeric/replay semantics, forbidden-overlap checks, coupling completeness, irreversible-input preservation, exact regeneration proof where claimed, hash/checkpoint verification and branch/provenance preservation

Feigenbaum delta approximately 4.66920160910299 and alpha approximately -2.5029078750958928 are retained as asymptotic scaling hints for verified period-doubling universality regimes, not exact finite-bifurcation generators; the real quadratic accumulation point is recorded approximately as c_infinity=-1.4011551890920506

adaptive fractal resolution is a candidate optimization only: Feigenbaum scaling may guide refinement, while exact states remain generator-derived and the method must beat uniform/adaptive baselines on measured cost
a new high-criticality generative_geometry kernel component and GENERATIVE_GEOMETRY test group are registered in Kernel Map and routed by Kernel Pulse

the deterministic v1 implementation provides complex quadratic stepping, logistic/quadratic transforms and conjugacy verification, critical-orbit materialization, escape-time calculation, full-4D state plus projection lenses, Feigenbaum scale hints, folded point-sector creation/copy/parameter move/visual move and deterministic point-sector unfolding

the current executable primitive intentionally supports POINT sectors only; broader RECT/PARAMETRIC_REGION/REFERENCE sector domains are represented by the contract/design but are not claimed as implemented runtime transforms yet

tests cover quadratic complex arithmetic, logistic/quadratic conjugacy, known c=0 and c=-1 orbits, escape behavior, 4D/projection separation, Feigenbaum hint semantics, deterministic fold/unfold, copy identity, parameter-move dynamics and presentation-only visual movement

Mission Gate self-test expanded from 16 to 20 cases to cover unproven geometry deletion, unknown coupling, local-vs-full unfold optimization and misuse of Feigenbaum delta as an exact finite generator

Kernel Pulse review run 33762839628 executed syntax checks for geometry and mission-gate code plus GENERATIVE_GEOMETRY, KERNEL_HANDSHAKE and MISSION_GATE checks; the resulting MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED state was expected for new protected component/governance semantics, with no unclassified executable files

no live PostgreSQL schema, ship table, database writer, Supabase Edge Function or production fleet runtime was modified by this transition; cryosleep and all post-recovery backup, audit and handshake gates remain authoritative
